upstream._comment_cutDate: Everything up to and including Kilo-Org/kilocode@30221fef52 (the tip merged in by the 791-commit catch-up merge commit 7c5bd60069) is already in keypool-live's history. git cherry's ancestry check already excludes these, but this is a cheap second guard against the agent re-considering them.

sync._comment_maxCommitsPerRun: Starting value carried over from the cline fork's tuning (evolutions.md): 10 commits/run risked exhausting the orchestrator's context window on a busy day; 8 is the compromise that still keeps a daily cadence realistic.
sync._comment_bulkMergeThreshold: Requires backport-agent >= 0.9.0. If a future gap ever again grows past 40 pending commits (this is what happened before the 2026-08-06 cutDate above), the agent switches from per-commit cherry-picking to one real `git merge` of the full range instead of repeating the 'massive repository-wide conflicts' failure loop every batch of maxCommitsPerRun. See backport-agent/README.md's 'Bulk merge mode' section.
sync._comment_createPullRequest: generate_report creates/updates a draft PR from the sync branch to keypool-live deterministically (backport-agent >= 0.8.0). Requires GITHUB_TOKEN (falls back to `gh auth token` since 0.8.2).

models._comment_fast: Orchestrator for the tool loop. Carried over from the cline fork's tuning — generous free tier, reliable in practice.
models._comment_powerful: Resolution fallback + consensus second opinion. Different vendor from the specialist (mistral) so cross-vendor consensus actually catches doubtful resolutions. Free tier for the user.

ai._comment: AI guardrails. minAutoApplyConfidence is enforced in code (host gate in apply_resolved_file), not just in the prompt.
ai._comment_enableConflictConsensus: A second independent resolution (models.powerful, a different vendor from models.specialist) is compared against the first; divergence => confidence low => blocked by the host gate.

validation._comment: test:invariants (deterministic invariant checks, <1s) is in every suite. See .backport-agent/check-fork-invariants.sh.
high: pushd packages/opencode && bun run typecheck && bun test ; popd
pushd packages/kilo-vscode && bun run typecheck && bun run lint ; popd
final: pushd packages/opencode && bun run typecheck && bun test ; popd
pushd packages/kilo-vscode && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit ; popd
pushd packages/kilo-vscode && bun run check-kilocode-change ; popd
